claims.claim: Employers must send a letter of compliance to The Pensions Regulator.
claims.quote: You must complete your declaration of compliance to tell us how you have met your legal duties.
claims.note: The required submission is a declaration of compliance; the regulator sends the employer a letter with a code.

claims.claim: The declaration of compliance must be completed within five months of the duties start date.
claims.quote: You must complete your declaration with The Pensions Regulator within five calendar months after your duties start date.
